layout.arrangement: White slide margin surrounding a full-size light-gray panel outlined with a thin dark-red border. Title sits top center-right (x ~40-82%, y ~8-15%) with a small yellow numbered badge '24' in the top-right corner. Directly below the title on the right is a white dashed-blue-bordered box containing the example sentence. The left half of the panel (x ~4-54%, y ~9-98%) is filled by one very large pale-cyan circle with a dashed blue border containing a word-attention graph of 6 word nodes, 11 red attention arrows (mostly double-headed, ~2-4pt), and 5 small blue embedding-vector icons. The right side shows the output of the operation: a large pink hatched block arrow pointing right, a green 'Boy' node with an orange vector icon (top right), and a second green 'Boy' node with a blue vector icon (bottom center-right) linked to the orange vector by a red dashed line.

layout.hierarchy: The title is the largest text (~28-30pt). The left attention circle dominates by area. Most visually salient colors are the red arrows, the green 'Boy' nodes, and the dashed blue borders. Node labels are bold and, within the same ~16-18pt range as the sentence text, appear larger and more prominent due to their bold weight; the '24' badge is small. The right-side result graphic is sparser and reads as the 'conclusion' of the left diagram.

visual_elements.description: Self-attention word graph inside one huge pale-cyan circle with dashed dark-blue border. Six circular word nodes: 'in' (top-left), 'garden' (top-right), 'the' (mid-left), 'Boy' (center, the only green node), 'tree' (mid-right), 'climbs' (bottom). Red arrows (mostly double-headed, thickness varies ~2-4pt, suggesting attention weights) connect: in<->garden; in<->the; in<->Boy [?]; the<->garden [?]; the<->Boy; the<->tree (long diagonal crossing the circle); Boy<->garden (THICK); Boy<->tree (thick); Boy<->climbs (thick, near-vertical); climbs<->tree [?]; garden<->tree (THICK, along right edge). Next to five of the nodes are small 'embedding vector' icons: rounded rectangles with blue outlines containing 4 stacked short horizontal light-blue bars, placed beside 'in' (left, outside circle edge), 'the' (lower-left), 'Boy' (right, inside circle), 'climbs' (right), 'tree' (below); 'garden' has no visible vector icon [?].
